now.title: Spider-Man (1994)
now.text: In episode 55, in Moscow, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant and leave Spider-Man and Robertson with a ticking bomb.

proposed.text: In episode 54, in Moscow, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant and leave Spider-Man and Robertson with a ticking bomb.

changes.evidence: The Wild Pack attack at the informant's house and the countdown bomb end episode 54 ('Six Forgotten Warriors', Chapter I). Episode 55 opens with Spider-Man escaping the explosion.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)
proposed.text: In episode 57, Silver Sable and the Wild Pack turn up to help Spider-Man when the Red Skull traps him, the Kingpin and the Insidious Six.

changes.evidence: Episode 57 ('The Six Fight Again'): 'Both sides are trapped by Red Skull as Silver Sable shows up to help Spider-Man.' Fandom: she frees the captive Six American Warriors and Spider-Man, then leaves. She changes sides and the file has no record of it.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)
proposed.text: In episode 38, Eddie rebonds with the symbiote to help Spider-Man and Iron Man stop Dormammu, then pulls Carnage into the portal to save Dr. Kafka and vanishes with him.

changes.evidence: End of episode 38 ('Carnage'): Eddie breaks the container to become Venom again, teams with Spider-Man and Iron Man, and sacrifices himself, going into Dormammu's portal with Carnage to save Ashley Kafka. The file stops at 'At large' with no record of this. The Missing status on k4 fits after it.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
proposed.text: In episode 33, Corsair leads the Starjammers in seizing the M'Kraan Crystal to trade to D'Ken, then flees as the crystal's power threatens the universe.
cases: FX-002 The M'Kraan Crystal Crisis (X-Men: The Animated Series)

changes.evidence: Phoenix Saga Parts IV-V (episodes 32-33): Corsair's Starjammers take Cyclops captive and extract the M'Kraan, Corsair bargains with D'Ken while planning revenge, and the Starjammers 'turn and run' as D'Ken's crystal consumes the universe. The file's only record is episode 44. 'after': -1 means it goes before k0.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 44, Corsair, hunted by the Shi'ar, is revealed to be Cyclops's father.
cases: FX-002 The M'Kraan Crystal Crisis (X-Men: The Animated Series)

changes.evidence: Episode 44 ('Orphan's End') is about Corsair being Cyclops's father and the Shi'ar hunting him. The M'Kraan Crystal crisis is the Phoenix Saga (episodes 29-33), so FX-002 belongs on the new episode 33 record.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 53, Gambit shields Nightcrawler from a mob in Germany. Fabian Cortez captures and tortures Gambit on Asteroid M.

proposed.text: In episode 53, after Fabian Cortez captures and tortures him on Asteroid M, Gambit shields Nightcrawler from a mob in Germany.

changes.evidence: Gambit is held on Asteroid M in 'Sanctuary' (episodes 48-49; Rogue looks for 'a missing Gambit' and the asteroid is destroyed in Part II). The Germany ski trip and the Nightcrawler mob are episode 53. The record's last event (Asteroid M) is not in episode 53, so the order is swapped to end on the episode 53 event.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
proposed.text: In episode 17, after outfitting the Master Planner's new Sinister Six, the Tinkerer is caught by Spider-Man while driving a van with Electro.

changes.evidence: Fandom: after helping form the second Sinister Six, he helped Doctor Octopus try to take command of the world's computers ('Shear Strength', episode 17) and 'while driving a van with Electro he was caught by Spider-Man'. The file has no record of this capture.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 22, as the Tinkerer, Mason gears up the Master Planner's Sinister Six, then builds new suits for the Big Man's Enforcers.

proposed.text: In episode 22, the Tinkerer builds new suits for the Big Man's Enforcers.

changes.evidence: This only applies if the episode 17 capture record is added: the Sinister Six gear-up (episodes 16-17) moves there, so this record keeps only its episode 22 event (Tinkerer enhances Shocker, Fancy Dan and Ox).

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 25, he leads Ricochet and Ox as the new Enforcers, until Spider-Man beats them and they are locked in the Vault.
cases: SV-018 The Vault Breakout (The Spectacular Spider-Man)

proposed.text: In episode 25, locked in the Vault after Spider-Man beats his new Enforcers, he joins the Green Goblin's mass breakout until the inmates are stopped.

changes.evidence: The New Enforcers (Shocker, Ricochet, Ox) are beaten and sent to the Vault in episode 22 ('Probable Cause'). The current text's last event is that episode 22 event, but it is tagged episode 25 and carries the Vault Breakout case. In episode 25 ('Opening Night') Montana joins the inmates' escape attempt, which Walter Hardy and Spider-Man foil.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
now.text: In episode 13, Spider-Man tricks the symbiote off Eddie and traps it in wet cement, and Eddie drops out of sight.

proposed.text: In episode 14, after Spider-Man tricks the symbiote off him and traps it in wet cement, Eddie drops out of sight.

changes.evidence: The separation is in 'Nature vs. Nurture' (episode 13). Eddie packs his things and goes AWOL in 'Blueprints' (episode 14). The record's last event, and its Missing status, belong to episode 14.

owner_calls.question: Step 0 (Into the Spider-Verse) is placed at 'Kingpin's collider (Earth-1610)', but Miles hits Ohnn with the bagel at the Alchemax lab, before the collider fight. Which place should it show?
options: Keep Kingpin's collider (Ohnn is later caught in its explosion)
Change to the Alchemax lab place, if the index has one
owner_calls.evidence: Spider-Man Wiki: Ohnn chases Miles and Peter B. Parker when they break into Alchemax and is hit by a bagel Miles throws. Later he is at the collider under Fisk Tower and is mutated when it explodes.

owner_calls.question: Step 3 marks the nation 'Deceased' after the massacre, and step 4 returns it to 'Active' when X-Corp moves into the ruins. No one comes back to life; the island is only reoccupied. Should a nation file use Deceased this way?
options: Keep Deceased then Active (the island is reborn as X-Corp's base)
Use another status for step 3 (for example Missing), keeping Active for step 4
Keep Deceased and treat step 4 as the island's ruins rather than a return
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 5: the Sentinels kill thousands of mutants on Genosha. Episode 16 ('Danger.exe'): with the X-Men banned, Xavier bases the team on Genosha and founds X-Corp.
